# V2: roots (Standard Profile 1)

Generated by gov5 from its execution and consensus code: receipts by `ApplyTransaction` on the standard genesis
(plus the V3 test sender, key = keccak256("n42-profile1-vectors-sender")), roots by `ReceiptsRootFor` /
`hash.DeriveSha`, committee evidence by `blspool.Pool.BuildSimulatedCE` and `ConsensusEvidence.Marshal` / `BeaconRoot`:
`go test -tags nosqlite,noboltdb ./internal -run 'TestProfile1VectorV2$'`
(`N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_UPDATE=1` rewrites the file; `N42_PROFILE1_VECTORS_MIRROR=<dir>` also writes it to `<dir>/V2/`).
The test fails if the file differs from what gov5 computes, or if a V5 header's parentBeaconRoot is not the one derived here.
gov5 commit: d4ef5137 (branch feat/p1-vectors-e2).

## Rules

- B7 receiptsRoot = `keccak256(concat(rlp([status, cumulativeGasUsed, logs])))`, log = `rlp([address, topics, data])`;
  no type byte, no bloom; `keccak256("") = 0xc5d24601...a470` when empty. Header N carries block N-1's root (A10).
- B6 withdrawalsRoot = `keccak256(concat(rlp([address, amount in wei])))` over the body's reward list in order;
  `keccak256("")` when empty. A8 rewards: `[coinbase, devFaucetAddress]`, `devBlockReward` each.
- B5 parentBeaconRoot of block N >= 2 = `Blake3-256(evidence)`, evidence = gov5's `ConsensusEvidence` encoding of the
  committee signature for (N-1, hash(N-1)) whose mobile section carries header N-1's `receiptsRoot`; zero for block 1.

## File `roots.json`

| Section | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `receiptsBlock`, `transactions`, `receipts` | one executed block: a CREATE whose initcode emits LOG2 (topics 0x11.., 0x22.., data 0x2a) and LOG0, a CREATE that reverts (status 0), a 1-wei transfer to the faucet; per receipt: status, cumulative gas, logs, its encoding |
| `receiptsRoots` | empty; receipt 0; receipt 1; all three |
| `withdrawalsRoots` | empty; the A8 pair; the pair reversed (order matters); one reward; 1 gwei and u64::MAX gwei; zero amount; each reward's encoding |
| `committeePool` | the genesis `committeePool` the evidence uses |
| `committeeEvidence` | V5-block-2..8: inputs from V5's `header_validity.json` parent header (number, hash, receiptsRoot), the active pool size, the 512 committee indexes, the signing message, signer bitmap, aggregate signature, the encoded evidence (405 bytes) and the parentBeaconRoot, checked against the V5 child header; `ramp`: made-up parents at rampBlocks/2, rampBlocks-1, rampBlocks |

The evidence encoding: `view u64 LE || blockHash || aggSig(96) || signerCount u16 LE || signersPacked ||
hasMobile(1) || mobReceiptsRoot || mobAggSig(96) || mobCount u16 LE || mobPacked || mobCreatedAtMs u64 LE` (gov5
`modules/rawdb/consensus_evidence.go`; mobCreatedAtMs = 0, mobile section = the committee section).

## Notes

- The plain transfer's receipt carries a log from `0xff..fe` with the ERC-20 Transfer topic: the Amsterdam EIP-7708
  ETH-transfer log, part of the receipts root.
- V5 already carries real receiptsRoot / withdrawalsRoot / parentBeaconRoot values in sealed headers; V2 adds the
  per-item encodings and the evidence bytes behind them.
